notes.title: " Absurd Story: Back Home" Demo Now Available on Steam!
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

We are thrilled to announce that the demo for Absurd Story: Back Home Demo is now officially available on Steam! This is a steampunk-style adventure exploration puzzle game that blends mysterious mythological elements, immersing you in a world where technology and mysticism coexist. Embark on a journey filled with enigmas and emotional depth.

[h2]Game Overview[/h2]
In a fictional world devastated by an apocalyptic catastrophe, the mechanic Zhuo Ruoshui returns to her hometown in search of her missing parents. However, what awaits her is a bizarre and surreal adventure. In this city transformed by disaster, a diverse cast of characters emerges—some old acquaintances, others complete strangers. As the exploration deepens, Zhuo Ruoshui gradually uncovers the buried truths while confronting her longing and obsession for her family.
[h3]Setting and Features[/h3]
A World Where Steampunk Meets Mythology: The game constructs a unique fictional era and city where technology and mythology coexist. The localized steampunk design adds a rich retro-futuristic and fantastical atmosphere.

Coarse Pixel Art: Meticulously crafted pixel-style visuals, paired with detailed character portraits, create a distinctive visual ambiance.

Nighttime and the Unknown: The game is predominantly set in nighttime environments, enhancing the sense of mystery and tension, with eerie unknown events lurking around every corner.
[h3]Stage and Cast[/h3]
Expansive Urban Setting: The city's districts and buildings serve as the primary stage for exploration, each hiding stories and secrets.

A Diverse Cast of Characters: Along the adventure, you will encounter a variety of individuals—some talented, others ordinary—but each plays a crucial role in the narrative.
[h3]Exploration and Puzzles[/h3]
Dual Protagonists and Multi-Timeline Narrative: Through the perspectives of two protagonists and the interweaving of multiple timelines, players will view the events from different angles, gradually solving puzzles and advancing the story.

Low-Difficulty Puzzle Design: To prioritize the narrative experience, puzzles are designed to be relatively simple, allowing players to focus more on the story.

[h2]Demo Content[/h2]
The demo offers a glimpse into the opening chapters of Absurd Story: Back Home, introducing players to the game's world, characters, and puzzle mechanics. You will follow Zhuo Ruoshui as she steps into this enigmatic city, beginning her quest to find her family.

[h2]Future Plans[/h2]
In the full release, we aim to expand the game's content, including more branching storylines, character interactions, and puzzle elements. We will also continue to optimize the experience based on player feedback.

Thank You for Your Support!

Absurd Story: Back Home is a labor of love from our team, and we hope to deliver an unforgettable adventure. If you're intrigued, head over to Steam to try out the demo and join our community to share your thoughts and suggestions!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2499510

Let’s embark on this journey filled with mysteries and emotions together!

Absurd Story Development Team
